from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareCountRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's weighted-average diluted shares outstanding for a reporting period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as appearing in the filing")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format, e.g., '2025-03'")
    diluted_shares_current: str | None = Field(description="Weighted-average diluted shares outstanding for current period, as written")
    diluted_shares_prior: str | None = Field(description="Weighted-average diluted shares outstanding for same period in prior year, as written")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the share count (e.g., 'thousand', 'million', or empty if raw count)")
    document_id: int | None = Field(description="Document number from 1-25 for conflict resolution")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_records: list[ShareCountRecord]
